_comment: Fitness function (docs/delivery.md, quality gates): the wasm-opt'ed module may not exceed its last measured size plus 25%. Spike S1 measured 437,223 B on 2026-11-04 (budget 546,529). PR 3 measured 1,353,901 B on 2026-11-05 (439,521 B before it): sign-in's argon2id, RS256 on rsa and HMAC-SHA256, the three objects and the new routes, plus about 39 KB for the seed generator. PR 4 measured 2,316,525 B on 2026-11-05 (1,353,901 B before it): the Catalog, Order and Kitchen objects with the domain's menu, order and board rules, the Sandbox's seeding of 14 children, the outbox relay, the Queue consumer and DLQ writer, and the menu, order, dead-letter and clock routes; reading object bodies with serde_json alone instead of serde-wasm-bindgen kept 136,666 B of it out. PR 5 measured 3,013,075 B on 2026-11-05 (2,316,525 B at PR 4; PR 5's domain stream could not be built alone, since the API did not compile until the Worker stream's changes): the Billing aggregate and its ledger, Stripe's wire types, the form encoder, the webhook signature check and the request builders in bakery-app, and in the Worker the Billing object, the Stripe adapter over fetch, the payment, refund, ledger and webhook routes, the Order's event and refund paths, and the Simulator's payments. The platform's limit is 64 MiB; this is a budget. Raise it only with a line saying what the bytes buy.
